audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart marks Pantheon on all 7 rows while its own whys, the content win[] and the packet chart all say Mel on all 7.
audit.why: Kit supports the Mel verdict: Mel Q is 950 range vs his 575 spear and 600 vault; Rebuttal reflects Comet Spear and blanks the vault damage; Solar Snare (1000) stops the walk-up. Full sides were the outlier — their whys already describe Mel winning.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to Mel with ratings adjusted; see chart edits.

audit.why: Spikes: his 3 (W-E-Q combo threat), your 6 (Golden Eclipse executes his commit; his R is a roam tool at 180s), your first item, your late game. spikes[] complete and kit-consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault being a Solar-Snare-cancellable channel was unstated; cooldowns field had no digits; Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted trade strings.
audit.why: Kit: his W 13s point-and-click stun/dash (Rebuttal-deniable per missing-interactions), E 22s channel with frontal invulnerability (any CC cancels; dodges timed burst), Q 25 mana 11s, R 180s. Mel W 38s.

47.08% over 1198 games. Tension noted: chart gives Mel 7/7 yet WR is sub-50 — kept, since kit, packet chart and content agree; the WR likely reflects his roam pressure, which the page already warns about.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Volley his 25-mana spear pokes back at him — Rebuttal reflects Comet Spear, and every reflected trade banks Overwhelm.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Burning Rebuttal on a poke spear and then eating the W-stun combo it existed to blank — the reflect answers the vault, not the chip.

edits.before: Pantheon wins by landing Shield Vault (Stun), denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Pantheon wins by landing the Shield Vault stun, chaining the empowered spear on the stunned target, and killing before your scaling talks.

edits.before: Good trade: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages. Bad trade: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Good trade: Volley his 25-mana spear pokes back at him — Rebuttal reflects Comet Spear, and every reflected trade banks Overwhelm. Bad trade: Burning Rebuttal on a poke spear and then eating the W-stun combo it existed to blank — the reflect answers the vault, not the chip.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 — his only gap-closer; after a whiffed or blocked vault you own the next ten seconds. - Aegis Assault is 22s: once spent he has no block, and Solar Snare cancels the channel outright. - Your W (38s) answers the vault, never the 25-mana spear.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Solar Snare's 1000 range beats his 600 vault — root the walk-up before Shield Vault is in reach and the all-in never starts.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: His Shield Vault is a 600-range point-and-click stun — keep moving between volleys, because a stationary Mel inside 600 is a stunned Mel.
